answer: A sybil-resistant economy ties every identity to a wharf of verified provenance: each new agent must dock and present a signed voyage log of completed work checked by independent harbormasters. Trust grows like a vine, each ring a verified epoch that cannot be grafted from another plant. An attacker forging a fleet must grow each vine from seed, paying full maturation cost per clone. Governance counts one established agent as one vote, collapsing any puppet fleet into weightless noise while its locked collateral evaporates.
